title: New World
summary: “From darkness, from stardust|, From memories of eons past and visions yet to come...”

sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Natural battles in End Barrens, End Highlands, End Midlands, Small End Islands, The End, and The Void.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Ancient Power, Black Hole Eclipse, Blood Moon, Comet Punch, Draco Meteor, Eternabeam, Future Sight, Hyperspace Fury, Hyperspace Hole, Light That Burns the Sky, Meteor Beam, Meteor Mash, Moonblast, Spacial Rend, Swift, Tachyon Cutter, Tera Starstorm, and Vacuum Wave: 2× stronger.

Aeroblast, Astral Barrage, Aurora Beam, Behemoth Bash, Behemoth Blade, Bleakwind Storm, Blue Flare, Bolt Strike, Collision Course, Continental Crush, Core Enforcer, Crush Grip, Dazzling Gleam, Diamond Storm, Double Iron Bash, Dragon Ascent, Dragon Energy, Dynamax Cannon, Earth Power, Electro Drift, Eruption, Fiery Wrath, Flash Cannon, Fleur Cannon, Freeze Shock, Freezing Glare, Fusion Bolt, Fusion Flare, Genesis Supernova, Glacial Lance, Glaciate, Hydro Steam, Ice Burn, Ivy Cudgel, Judgment, Land's Wrath, Lumina Crash, Luster Purge, Magma Storm, Malignant Chain, Menacing Moonraze Maelstrom, Mighty Cleave, Mind Blown, Mirror Shot, Mist Ball, Moongeist Beam, Multi-Attack, Mystical Power, Oblivion Wing, Origin Pulse, Photon Geyser, Plasma Fists, Power Gem, Precipice Blades, Prismatic Laser,

Psyblade, Psycho Boost, Psystrike, Relic Song, Roar of Time, Sacred Fire, Sacred Sword, Sandsear Storm, Searing Shot, Searing Sunraze Smash, Secret Sword, Seed Flare, Shadow Force, Signal Beam, Soul-Stealing 7-Star Strike, Spectral Thief, Springtide Storm, Steam Eruption, Sunsteel Strike, Surging Strikes, Techno Blast, Thousand Arrows, Thousand Waves, Thunder Cage, Thunderclap, Thunderous Kick, V-create, Wicked Blow, and Wildbolt Storm: 1.5× stronger.
Bulldoze, Earthquake, and Magnitude: weakened to 0.25×.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Dark-type.
Secret Power can lower the target's Attack, lower the target's Defense, lower the target's Special Attack, lower the target's Special Defense, and lower the target's Speed.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Geomancy changes the field into Starlight Arena.
Tera Starstorm changes the field into Starlight Arena. The old field returns when the new one ends or is removed.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Magical Seed: Attack +1, Defense +1, Special Attack +1, Special Defense +1, Speed +1, and must recharge.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
